Commentary.Commentary: What an anticlimactic finish to this competitive tri-series! Very unfortunate. Rain just refused to relent and the umpires were forced to ABANDON the grand finale. The trophy is shared by Afghanistan and Bangladesh. Both were decent in this series and have had their fair share of inconsistencies and indifferent form of their players. The Afghan dominated the first leg while the Bangla Tigers roared back in the second. We will sign off by putting forward one weakness each of these two sides. Afghanistan - In back-to-back games, their openers provided a fabulous start but then the wickets fell in a heap to spoil all the good work. This is one area they need to improve. Bangladesh - Over-reliance on the experienced players is too much. Apart from Afif in the first game, there wasn't much from the lesser-known players. They were so poor that the hosts had to revamp their squad midway. Plenty of work needed to be done in their build-up to the T20 World Cup next year. That's all from us here. Looking forward to your company in the near future. Cheers!
